## Overview

The **`dataprocessor`** package aims to develop tools to analyze sgRNA data and predictive factors for sgRNA quality in CRISPR screens. It includes functions for preprocessing data, building predictive models, and generating visualizations.

## Features

-   Analyze data from sgRNAs and their surrounding genes\
-   Train machine learning models\
-   Generate plots to evaluate models

## Installation

Check out the [**GitHub repository**](https://github.com/pastaalfredos/crispr-screen) for detailed installation instructions.
